supersedes_for_future_design_only: The v0.1 umbrella treated environmental niche similarity as the default primary relation. No fresh relational genetic response was opened under that choice.
reason_for_role_split: Response-blind external-data audits now show a mechanism-specific host-resource relation with a large fresh Lepidoptera dyad panel and weak dependence on geographic support, while the cross-taxon environmental relation still requires provider and raster feasibility work. This design update uses no nucleotide identity, pairwise genetic distance, T_st, beta_R, or ecology-genetics association.

study_A_mechanistic_primary.question: Does source-target similarity in host-resource landscapes predict transferability of post-IBD spatial genetic structure?

study_B_cross_taxon_generalization.question: Does a general habitat relation predict transferability across broad taxa?
study_B_cross_taxon_generalization.status: response-blind feasibility only; it cannot rescue or redefine Study A

claim_logic.A_positive: mechanistic evidence that transferability is relational with respect to host-resource landscapes within Lepidoptera
claim_logic.B_positive: external generalization to a broad habitat relation across taxa
claim_logic.A_null_with_power: host-resource similarity does not explain dyadic transfer heterogeneity in the frozen Lepidoptera design
claim_logic.B_null_with_power: the frozen broad environmental relation does not generalize relational transfer across the tested taxa
